MARKET_DETAIL.MarketBoundariesDescription: North Bellmore is generally bounded by Hempstead Turnpike to the north, Jerusalem Avenue to the south, Newbridge Road to the west, and Bellmore Avenue to the east. The neighborhood is primarily residential and is part of the Town of Hempstead in Nassau County.
MARKET_DETAIL.MarketInventorySearchParameterDescriptio: North Bellmore is a suburban residential area consisting primarily of single-family homes, with local schools, parks, and neighborhood commercial services. The area has mature residential development and convenient access to surrounding communities and major roadways.

MARKET_TREND.PriceTrendsAnalysisDescription: Per One Key MLS, 27 sales closed in the trailing 12 months with a median price of $1,150,000, against 24 active listings (median list $1,100,000) and 27 pending sales at a median 90 days on market. Closed prices trending at or slightly above list price, with no distressed competition, supports a stable, balanced market.

SALES_COMPARISON_APPROACH_DETAIL.SalesComparisonCommentDescription: Most weight was given to Comparable 2 due to its similarity in design, bedroom count, age, and lot size.
